product.name: Stage Right by Monoprice 60W White COB LED DMX Ellipsoidal Stage Light with 13 ~ 35-degree Beam Manual Zoom 3200k
product.description: This light fixture features a single, 60‑watt 3200K white LED and a 13° ~ 35° adjustable beam angle. It allows for manual control over the beam size, using four independently adjustable shutters, focus, and zoom, as well as 3‑channel DMX512 control for the dimmers and built‑in programs. It includes built in Strobe, Fade, and Auto programs and can be configured as a DMX Slave light.
